name: Delicious Glupov Rye Bread
desc: A dense, hearty loaf of bread. A single bite brings a steady, gentle tartness, followed by the uniquely rustic, grainy aroma of rye. It carries a heavy richness that makes every chew incredibly satisfying, culminating in a lingering sweetness at the back of your throat like a vibrant spark of life buried under the frozen earth.

value.text: Restores 22% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 470 HP every 5s for 30s.
